description: A Git client in one panel: stage files and hunks, commit (amend, commit all, push, an AI message), the commit graph with a search, branches, tags, remotes, worktrees and stashes. Fetch, pull and push in its bar.

credit.text: Based on Git Graph for Herdr by rabeeh-ta (MIT license).

settings.label: Diff view
settings.hint: Unified: removed and added lines one under the other. Split: the old file on the left and the new file on the right.

settings.label: Pull
settings.hint: How the Pull button joins the remote commits. Git config: what pull.rebase and pull.ff say. Fast-forward only: it stops when the branches went apart.

settings.label: Fetch prunes
settings.hint: Fetch removes the remote branches that are gone from the remote (--prune).

settings.label: AI program
settings.hint: The program that writes the commit message. Auto: Claude Code when it is installed, else Codex. It runs on the machine of the repository.

settings.label: AI model
settings.hint: Empty: haiku for Claude Code, gpt-6-luna for Codex.

settings.label: Message format
settings.hint: Same as the repository: the model copies the style of the last 20 commit subjects. Conventional Commits: type(scope): subject. Free: a short subject and a body.

settings.placeholder: Write in English. Mention the ticket key.
settings.label: Extra instructions
settings.hint: Text added to the request to the model, for every message.
